adjudication.rationale: In `parseRefreshTokenResponse` (new file `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`), the function calls `safeParse(...)` but immediately `throw`s if `!refreshTokenResponse.success`, and then returns the `safeParse` result. Therefore, in `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the subsequent `if (!accessTokenParsed.success) { ... }` branch is unreachable because failures would have already thrown. This indicates an inconsistent/unclear contract: call sites treat the return as a SafeParse result (checking `.success`), but the helper behaves like a throwing validator on failure.
